sourceRefs.locator: Écrans 3–7, printed pp. 19–22. Peat-bog find in 1870, battle of 524, the hypothetical identification with Chlodomer, gilding, six T-shaped bands and rivets.

summary.de: Der 1870 in einem Torfmoor gefundene Helm zeigt Reste einer Vergoldung. Wer ihn getragen hatte, bleibt offen.
summary.en: The helmet found in a peat bog in 1870 has traces of gilding. Its original wearer is unknown.
